items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: I believe they played in a soccer, but I think Jaffee said they played for something like 40 nights in a row.

ctx.x: Then, then there were several concerts in Tokyo. Then went to Osaka, to the Shin-Ozaka Hotel, where the band stayed and I stayed too. And there was a music hall around the corner. Again, absolutely huge, very plush. And now a fantastically enthusiastic response because Osaka was the center of the Japanese, the Dixieland Rascals, the Japanese band. And it was a fantastic And it was just mobbed. And terribly successful. And in the lobby of the hotel, there was a great chance for the Japanese to get to know the…

I believe they played in a soccer, but I think Jaffee said they played for something like 40 nights in a row. Yep. Is that right? He said that they were actually, that the festival hall where it was there, and they were actually packed out more every night.
Every night, 40 nights, I think roughly is correct. That is really extraordinary. Absolutely packed.
